سياسة الإلغاء لدينا كالتالي:

1. يمكن للأعضاء إلغاء حجز أي ملعب مجاناً حتى ست ساعات قبل وقت بدء الحجز.
2. الإلغاءات التي تتم خلال هذه الفترة تتم تلقائياً عبر التطبيق أو بوابة الأعضاء دون الحاجة للتواصل مع الموظفين.
3. الإلغاءات التي تتم بعد هذه الفترة وحتى قبل بدء الجلسة تخضع لشروط إلغاء متأخر.
4. في حالة الإلغاء المؤهل لاسترداد المبلغ، يتم إرجاع الأموال إلى محفظة العضو في النادي لاستخدامها في حجوزات أو خدمات مستقبلية.
5. الحجوزات في أوقات الذروة (الصباح الباكر، المساء، وعطلات نهاية الأسبوع) تخضع لشروط إلغاء أكثر صرامة، حيث لا يتم استرداد المبلغ إذا تم الإلغاء خلال 12 ساعة من وقت الحجز.
6. يمكن للأعضاء نقل الحجز إلى لاعب آخر مسجل بدلاً من الإلغاء.
7. عدم الحضور (No-Show) يتم تحصيل الرسوم كاملة عنه دون استرداد.
8. جلسات التدريب الخاصة لها سياسة إلغاء منفصلة بمدة إشعار 24 ساعة.

You cannot leave your 6-year-old child unattended at the club while you play. Children under twelve must be accompanied onto the premises by a parent, guardian, or a nominated adult of at least eighteen years, who must remain within the club premises or confirm an agreed collection window with reception before departing. Coaches and duty managers are not permitted to accept responsibility for a child under twelve without documented handover. Junior players under twelve must be supervised at all times while on club premises, including communal areas. 

So, your child must be accompanied and supervised while you play.

If it rains during your outdoor booking at Baseline Padel, the booking will be cancelled due to weather conditions and you will receive a full credit to your member account within 48 hours. This credit expires 90 days from the date it is issued. You do not need to submit a claim as weather-related cancellations are logged automatically by club staff once a court is deemed unplayable. This policy applies only to outdoor bookings; indoor bookings are not eligible for weather credit. 

If you believe a weather credit has been missed, you can contact the front desk or use the app's support chat with your booking reference for review.

If you cancel a padel court booking at any Baseline Padel branch in the UAE two hours before the scheduled time, the cancellation falls within the 6-hour window before the session. According to the Booking & Cancellation Policy:

- Cancellations made inside the 6-hour window before the booking start time are not eligible for any refund or wallet credit.
- The court is held exclusively for you during this peak scheduling period and cannot typically be reallocated on short notice.
- Therefore, cancelling two hours before the scheduled time means you will not receive a refund or credit.

If you want to avoid charges, cancellations must be made more than 6 hours before the session start time.
